string-array.name: app_guide_section1_steps_mz
string-array.item: Home screen-ah tun huna khawchin dinhmun a lang nghal ang.
A hnuai lamah scroll la, darkar tin leh ni tin thlirlawkna i hmu ang.

string-array.name: app_guide_section1_steps_en
string-array.item: On the home screen, the current weather shows first.
Scroll down to see hourly and daily forecasts.

string-array.name: app_guide_section2_steps_mz
string-array.item: "+" button emaw "Report Weather" tih kha hmet rawh.
Ruah sur dan thlang rawh - Tih ngei ngei tur.
Van awmdan, thli leh note te i duh chuan belh rawh - Tih kher a ngai lo.
A tawpah "Submit" hmet rawh le!

string-array.name: app_guide_section2_steps_en
string-array.item: Tap the "+" button or "Report Weather".
Select rain intensity (required).
Add sky condition, wind and notes if you want (optional).
Finally, tap "Submit".

string-array.name: app_guide_section3_steps_mz
string-array.item: Report i thehluh apiangin Points i hmu zel ang.
Achievement hrang hrang ti hlawhtling la, Badge la khawm rawh.
Leaderboard-ah midang nen inkhaikhin rawh u!

string-array.name: app_guide_section3_steps_en
string-array.item: You earn points for each report.
Complete achievements to collect badges.
Compare with others on the leaderboard.

string-array.name: app_guide_section4_steps_mz
string-array.item: I awmna hmun tak atangin report thehlut thin rawh.
Thu dik chiah report rawh - dawt report chuan i "Trust Level" a ti hniam ang.
Report i thehluh ngun chuan i "Trust Level" a sang zel ang.

string-array.name: app_guide_section4_steps_en
string-array.item: Submit reports from your actual location.
Report accurately; false reports lower your trust level.
Consistent reporting increases your trust level.

string-array.name: crowd_section1_points_mz
string-array.item: Community-based data - Mipui tangrualin khawchin kan khawnkhawmna a ni.
Real reports - Khawchin dinhmun dik tak, a hmun ngeia awm ten an report a ni.
Accuracy - Hei hian mi zawng zawng tana khawchin thlirlawkna (forecast) dik zawk siamna a tanpui a ni.

string-array.name: crowd_section1_points_en
string-array.item: Community-based data: weather data collected together by people.
Real reports: actual conditions reported by people on-site.
Accuracy: helps improve forecasts for everyone.

string-array.name: crowd_section2_points_mz
string-array.item: Combination - I report leh weather station data te kha chawhpawlh a ni.
Machine Learning - AI hmangin user rintlak dan (reputation) a zirin report hi teh a ni.
Influence - Report dik zawk = Reputation sang zawk = I thu a tlang zawk.

string-array.name: crowd_section2_points_en
string-array.item: Combination: your reports are combined with station data.
Machine learning: AI weighs reports based on user reputation.
Influence: accurate reports raise reputation and influence.

string-array.name: crowd_section3_points_mz
string-array.item: Start - User thar te chu 50% reputation-ah an tan ang.
Increase - Report dik tak i thehluhin i reputation a sang zel ang.
Verify - I report leh weather station/midang report a inmilin score a sang thin.
Rewards - Reputation sang chuan Trust Level 4, badge leh leaderboard-ah hmun a chang thei.

string-array.name: crowd_section3_points_en
string-array.item: Start: new users begin at 50% reputation.
Increase: accurate reports raise reputation.
Verify: matching stations/others increases score.
Rewards: high reputation unlocks trust levels, badges, and leaderboard.

string-array.name: crowd_section4_points_mz
string-array.item: Location - I awmna (Location) hi khawchin mapping atan chauh hman a ni.
Safe - Mimal chanchin engmah midang hmuh turin a lang lo.
Anonymous - Hming thup (Anonymous) pawhin a tel theih.

string-array.name: crowd_section4_points_en
string-array.item: Location is used only for weather mapping.
Safe: personal details are not shown to others.
Anonymous users can participate.

string-array.name: crowd_section5_points_mz
string-array.item: Nowcast - I report atangin khawchin dik lo a awmin minute 30 chhungin siamthat a ni.
Learning - AI chuan i awmna hmun (tlang/ruam) a zira khawchin danglam dan a zir zel.
Microclimate - Satellite-in a hmuh phak loh, i awmna hmun bik khawchin hriat nan a tangkai.
Blending - Station Weight 70% + Mipui Report 30% in data chawhpawlh a ni.
Trust - Report dik thawn thin mi te chuan forecast-ah influence an nei zawk.

string-array.name: crowd_section5_points_en
string-array.item: Nowcast: reports can fix short‑term forecasts within 30 minutes.
Learning: AI learns local differences (hills/plains).
Microclimate: detects local weather that satellites miss.
Blending: 70% station data + 30% public reports.
Trust: reliable reporters have more influence.
